camel_example: aliyun live DescribeLiveRealtimeDeliveryAcc --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:05:00Z' --LogStore logstore_example --DomainName 'example.com' --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Interval 3600
description_en: Invokes DescribeLiveRealtimeDeliveryAcc to query the number of real-time log delivery attempts
description_zh: 调用DescribeLiveRealtimeDeliveryAcc查询实时日志投递次数
kebab_example: aliyun live describe-live-realtime-delivery-acc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2015-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T21:05:00Z --interval 3600 --project project_example --log-store logstore_example --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLiveRealtimeDeliveryAcc

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC). The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and end time cannot exceed one year
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 结束时间需大于起始时间。起止时间和结束时间，间隔不超过一年
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

300
3600
86400

If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value is 300 seconds when the time span does not exceed 3 days, 3600 seconds when the time span exceeds 3 days, and 86400 seconds when the time span exceeds 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度。单位：秒（s）。取值：

300。
3600。
86400。

不传或传的值不支持，且时间跨度不超过3天时，默认值300秒。超过3天默认值3600秒。超过30天默认值86400秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The Project for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Projects is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 实时日志投递的Project。若参数为空，默认返回所有Project合并后数据
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The Logstore for real-time log delivery. If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all Logstores is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 实时日志投递的Logstore。若参数为空，默认返回所有Logstore合并后数据
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en:
The streaming domain.
You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
If this parameter is not specified, the merged data of all live streaming domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
播流域名。
支持单个或批量域名查询。批量查询时多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。
若参数为空，默认返回所有直播域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name
